definitions.dark: a one-photon block whose ideal algebra-mode probability p_algebra is 0: x y = 0, so the photon leaves only through the dilation ports and any algebra-mode detection is implementation error
definitions.bright: a one-photon block with p_algebra = 1: ||x y||^2 = 2, so the photon never reaches a dilation port
definitions.half: a strut, non-kite or four-label block with p_algebra = 1/2, independent of the signs s and t

preregistered.observable: per block, the fraction a of detected samples whose photon lands on an algebra mode (roles other than dilation), counted on the samples with exactly one click inside the block; the full per-mode histogram is kept, since the dilation split carries the direction of y in the kernel
preregistered.ideal: a equals the block's p_algebra; the per-mode ideal is the exact |U[k][0]|^2 of circuit.json
preregistered.simulator_stop_rule: on sim:belenos, any algebra-mode sample of a dark block or dilation-mode sample of a bright block, or a half block outside |z| < 4.5 of its binomial, stops the series until the circuit, the compiler or the simulator's noise model explains it
preregistered.hardware_report: on qpu:belenos, the dark floor a_dark, the bright ceiling a_bright, the contrast a_bright - a_dark, the total variation distance of each per-mode histogram from its ideal and the one-hot leakage into the 14 unreachable labels, each with a Wilson 95% interval and the dark counts of the detectors involved
preregistered.layout: each job holds the block set of the same-numbered box_kite_photonic_packed job with every block on the slot three places along (modes 12-23 then 0-11), so each block's modes differ from its packed run and its job neighbors stay the same; a block's residual a - p that follows the block is an algebra or compilation property, one that follows the slot is a per-mode source, transmission or detector property

mode_swap.pairing: block (m, t) of job-NN here against the same block in the same-numbered job of box_kite_photonic_packed on qpu:belenos, both counted on the samples with exactly one click inside the block
mode_swap.observable: the residual r = a - p of each of the 16 half blocks (p = 1/2) and the leakage of each dark (a) and bright (1 - a) block, per layout
mode_swap.block_predictor: r_swapped(b) = r_packed(b), the residual belongs to the block
mode_swap.slot_predictor: r_swapped(b) = the mean packed-layout residual of the other half blocks on the slot that b occupies here, the residual belongs to the modes
mode_swap.statistics: the Pearson correlation of r_swapped with each predictor over the 16 half blocks, its Fisher-z 95% interval, and per block the two-sample z of a_swapped - a_packed
mode_swap.decision: block attribute when the block predictor's correlation exceeds 0.7 with a lower bound above 0.3 and exceeds the slot predictor's; slot attribute for the reverse; mixed otherwise, and a 16-block correlation cannot distinguish a mixture's weights
mode_swap.falsifier: a block whose |a_swapped - a_packed| exceeds 4.5 standard errors is a placement effect; a dark or bright block whose leakage moves with its slot places the 14% outlier in the modes
